$Comment: The Grave Candle, the price of the Headless Horseman's graveyard: the Gravekeeper burns one to open the gate for a party, and Old Jack sells them at his stall (ShopEntries/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Offer_Grave_Candle.json). The Horseman's Hoards pay some back (a chance at one on the normal ride, one to four on the hard ride: ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase*.json), and Old Jack trades ten for a Burning Grave Candle. Hallows_Eve_Graveyard.json under ZiggfreedCommon/Dungeons names it in its EntryCost, so change the count there; the hard ride takes the Burning Grave Candle (Hallows_Eve_Burning_Grave_Candle.json beside this file) instead. A plain item that only sits in the bag: no BlockType, so it can never be placed, and no recipe. It wears the game's own Human Ruins candle (its model, texture and icon), a single dark candle, so it needs no art of its own. MaxStack is how many fit in one slot; DropOnDeath false keeps it in the bag when its owner falls.
